question: This is my first time sending in!! I heard you're working on a cover series, right? My dad said that the characters that appear in them might not show up anymore, so what's the story behind that? Sakura
answer: Eh? That's not true. The cover series I've done so far have been: [Buggy · Koby · Jango · Hatchan · Wapol · Ace · Gedatsu · Meet Baroque · Enel  ||  CP9 · Caribou · Jinbe · Straw Hat Grand Fleet · Bege · Germa · Yamato] There's a lot going on in the main story. Most of the characters are returning. But what are they doing before they reappear? I want the reader to know what they're doing while they're gone. That's the point of the cover story. There's also a book called Doors! which makes it easy to read them. Mi Sakura-chan, are you wondering if Yamato will appear again? Look forward to the possibility! lol
name: Mi Sakura
